title: type=calculate rows must not have readonly=yes
description: Any survey row with type=calculate must NOT have readonly=yes. OC rejects the form with "Element [name] cannot be defined as type=calculate and readonly. This element will never be visible on the form." type=calculate is always hidden; readonly is only valid on visible fields. Remove readonly from all type=calculate rows.
rationale: OC form validator treats type=calculate + readonly as a hard error. These fields are background computations consumed by other expressions — they are never rendered to the data-entry user, so readonly is semantically meaningless and syntactically forbidden. The companion convention (validate.calculate_requires_readonly) enforces readonly=yes on non-calculate types with calculations; this convention is the inverse guard for calculate types.

flag.message: Field ${field.name} on ${form.form_id} had type=calculate with readonly=yes — readonly stripped. type=calculate rows are hidden background computations; OC rejects readonly on them.

source: OC form validator error: cannot be defined as type=calculate and readonly

history.note: Created to complement validation.calculate_requires_readonly. Confirmed OC rejection on Detroit DS New: ECONSENT ACKNOWLEDGE_CALC and BIOIVTONC ORG_SITE_CALC both had type=calculate + readonly=yes.
